description: Search the Vivid Ads catalogue by product name, category, or intended use (e.g. 'corflute', 'pull up banner', 'expo', 'shopfront'). Returns matching products grounded in Vivid's own Shopify collections, so it also surfaces same-range, same-purpose alternatives — products flagged `sameRange:true` come from the top match's curated collection (returned as `collection`). ALWAYS mention these to the customer (e.g. 'we have two Pull Up Banner options, and Fabric Banner Stands do the same job'). Treat a from-price as INDICATIVE only — use vivid_product for options then vivid_price for the exact configuration. Paginated: returns `total`, `has_more` and `next_offset`; pass `offset` to get the next page.

offset.description: skip this many results — use next_offset from the previous page (default 0)

query.description: what the customer is looking for (a product name, a category, or a use-case like 'expo' or 'shopfront')

name: vivid_search

from.description: indicative from-price, AUD incl. GST — NOT a configured price

product.description: product handle — pass to vivid_product / vivid_price

sameRange.description: true = same-range alternative from the top match's collection

status.description: outcome discriminator, e.g. ok / priced / need_size / manual_quote / unknown_product / error

title: Search catalogue
